about: Counter rows (felizjueves.measured_store, #110): the card's own performance counters, as a profiler reported them for ONE BATCH KERNEL of one cell, keyed device.MeasuredKey(spec, arch, toolchain).key() + '#<batch>', the kernel's 0-based position in the cell's plan order. A cell's counters are derived (summed over its kernels), never stored. Observations of a profiler on one card, not claims about this code. NOT comparable to [JEngine, v2, Fig. 7]: their kernels, their A100.

header.what: One row per batch kernel: what a profiler's counters said about one launch of one emitted kernel on one card (felizjueves.measured_store, #110).
header.key: MeasuredKey(spec, arch, toolchain).key() + '#<batch>': the generation Spec, the card's Arch, the COMPILER that built the kernel, and the kernel's 0-based index in the cell's plan order (measured.cell_kernels). A cell of n_batches b has exactly the rows #0 .. #b-1; the loader refuses any other set.
header.cell: A cell's counters are measured_store.cell_counters: every count summed over its kernels (each launched once per class). Derived, never stored, so the per-kernel and per-cell verdicts read one set of numbers.
header.counters: #110: fp64_flops, dram_bytes_read, dram_bytes_written and counter_ns are the card's own performance counters as a profiler reported them for one kernel -- ncu on NVIDIA (fp64_flops = dadd + dmul + 2 x dfma thread instructions; DRAM bytes at sector granularity), rocprofv3's counter mode on AMD (GL2C <-> EA bytes, an upper bound on DRAM; gfx1200 has no fp64 counter, so fp64_flops is None there) -- with the profiler in counter_tool, the vendor meaning in counter_unit, the invocation in command and every counter by its exact name in raw. counter_ns is the kernel's duration under counter collection (serialised, replayed): NOT a timing, never runtime_ns. The counts are canonical; arithmetic_intensity and achieved_flops_per_s are derived, never stored. Units: fp64_flops: fp64 floating-point operations executed (FMA = 2); dram_bytes_read: bytes (vendor meaning: the row's counter_unit); dram_bytes_written: bytes (vendor meaning: the row's counter_unit); counter_ns: ns, the profiler's kernel duration under counter collection -- NOT a timing; arithmetic_intensity: FLOP / byte = fp64_flops / (dram_bytes_read + dram_bytes_written), derived; achieved_flops_per_s: FLOP / s = fp64_flops / counter_ns, derived. Counter rows live in data/measured/roofline.json, ONE PER BATCH KERNEL, keyed MeasuredKey.key() + '#<batch>' (plan order, from 0); a cell's counters are their sum, derived (measured_store.cell_counters), never stored. NOT comparable to [JEngine, v2, Fig. 7]: their kernels, their A100.
header.not_timing: counter_ns is the kernel's duration under counter collection, which serialises and replays kernels: never a timing. Wall-clock lives in kernels.json's runtime_ns, and a row here carries none.
header.not_compared: Nothing here is compared against [JEngine, v2, Fig. 7] (their kernels, their A100), nor across vendors (the fields share a name, not a meaning: see counter_unit).
